mechanism: Clotrimazole inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, potentially increasing propylthiouracil levels and hepatotoxicity risk; propylthiouracil may increase azole antifungal metabolism.
action: Monitor liver function tests and thyroid function more frequently; consider alternative antifungal if possible; assess for signs of propylthiouracil toxicity (agranulocytosis, hepatitis).
